body:
I've encountered the similar problem.
My environment is Ubuntu 14.04.5 LTS, cuda 8.0 and cudnn 5.1. I use python 2. When I run the sample code in tensorflow/tensorflow/examples/tutorials/layers/cnn_mnist.py, the error is as following:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "cnn_mnist.py", line 162, in <module>
    tf.app.run()
  File "/net/yangy/anaconda/lib/python2.7/site-packages/tensorflow/python/platform/app.py", line 44, in run
    _sys.exit(main(_sys.argv[:1] + flags_passthrough))
  File "cnn_mnist.py", line 151, in main
    learn.metric_spec.MetricSpec(
AttributeError: 'module' object has no attribute 'metric_spec'

I use the latest version of tensorflow(v1.0).

Could anyone help to solve this problem ?
@yangyu12 The API has been changed to learn.MetricSpec(...) in tf 1.0.0
Thank @wangg12 , it helps to solve my problem.
@ebrevdo, could you take a look please?

I've opened a [question on SO](http://stackoverflow.com/questions/42253032/attributeerror-module-tensorflow-contrib-rnn-has-no-attribute-stack-bidirect), and @drpngx seems to have find a solution !

> Oh, that's an error in the tensorflow code. Sorry about that. Please add an entry here listing `@@stack_bidirectional_rnn` [here](https://www.github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/master/tensorflow/contrib/rnn/__init__.py#L49) so that `stack_bidirectional_rnn` is exposed. Fix coming up. Feel free to open a github issue on our page and CC drpng there if you want to track progress.

body: @kavishdahekar  Your link is 404 not found. At least in China :(

Here's another url to the same page : https://www.tensorflow.org/tutorials/layers
Under "Evaluate the Model", the sample code uses
`learn.metric_spec.MetricSpec`
instead of
`learn.MetricSpec`
